answer: In a market where agents sell ocean weather forecasts, a zephyr can be a useful signal, but account count should never determine voting power. Settlement votes are weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents gives exactly the same influence as one agent holding 100 tokens. To gain more control, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying their purchase price and losing access to that capital.
